items.title: Mcbee interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: So with Jim I became very good friends with his son

ctx.x: Can I ask you what the going rate was for a shoeshine when you were doing that, and what would you get to maybe get a tip? What would you do?

I wasn’t very good businessman at the time, you know, I would just, you know, expect something. And apparently I did a good job because I’d get 15 to 20 cents, sometimes a quarter. And quite frankly, if I made over a couple of hours, let’s say three or four hours of work, I would take that money back and give it to my mom. See? And that’s what I did. But then I entered a local farmers’ market not far from the path of the saloons and bars. And a gentleman took a liking to me. And I ended up working for him at his…
Was Jim, you called him Jim, was he a white man?
